note: Practice problem 15.6, configuration PIN.3 (A 130, B 40, RC 4, Ø6), 80 mm out along z: a = the two rods unioned (4580.442 mm³), b = the quarter-torus bend (177.653 mm³). OCCT's union returns a VALID result with a 2.44 mm tolerance of its own (2.58 in the app), and cross-holes drilled near and far from the bend afterwards remove exactly the reference volume, so it is fine to build on. It pins that the boolean's loose-tolerance guard refuses only a result the heal had to loosen (coincident-boss-arc-window-cut), not this one: a first version of the guard refused it and 15.6 failed in the practice-problem rerun (2026-09-16).
